subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this DeepSeek-only automatic trailing-carrier policy with a public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` opt-out, or select the config-free sibling policy instead?
rationale: Both branches address the proven regression, but whether OpenClaw should permanently expose a compatibility key and automatically change existing DeepSeek request shaping is a provider/product contract decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Adopt this compat contract
options.body: Accept the DeepSeek-only default and explicit opt-out, resolve the main conflict, and retain the branch's focused tests and live provider proof.

options.title: Use the config-free sibling
options.body: Pause this PR and select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94945 only after it provides equivalent authority-preserving behavior, current-main integration, and live DeepSeek proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt this compat contract
